cues.text: Which Tom Holland is smiling, A or B?

delivery.direction: Immediate and curious. Let the question land.

cues.text: Look beside his nose. On one side, the cheek bunches up enough to deepen that little crease.

delivery.direction: Keep the brisk natural rhythm of the same narration.

cues.text: Now watch. That’s the grin you were seeing before you could see his mouth.

delivery.direction: Keep the brisk natural rhythm of the same narration.

cues.text: Try the same comparison with two of your own photos, then check the mouth section on Mogging.com to see what the neutral one shows.

delivery.direction: Keep the brisk natural rhythm of the same narration.

voice.direction: Independent narrator, never imitate the person pictured. Brisk, upbeat conversational English, approximately 205 words per minute. Tell one connected story with natural contractions, purposeful emphasis and distinct energy for setup, evidence and payoff. Read the exact transcript in order, without additions, paraphrasing or omitted brand names. Keep pauses brief but let the visual idea land. No slow documentary voice, dramatic trailer delivery, monotone list or advertising voice. Maintain the same natural pace through product mentions. Mogging.com is pronounced Mogging dot com; Mogging rhymes with dog. Read scores clearly.
